services.value: Provides cleanroom testing and certification services (including particle counts, HEPA filter integrity/velocity, viable air and surface sampling, and IQ/OQ/PQ), facility qualification, and pharmacy cleanroom certification including USP <797> and USP <800> services. Also offers validation and compliance support such as facility systems validation (e.g., GMP suites, USP purified water, WFI/water systems) and environmental monitoring services including cleanroom qualification and controlled environment monitoring.
